title: Individual and strong pure infiniteness
exact_target: If every positive element of a complex C*-algebra is properly infinite in Cuntz comparison, must the algebra be strongly purely infinite, with simultaneous two-element diagonalization, without exactness, nuclearity, unitality or simplicity assumptions?
